definition.odd_symmetrization: For use as an odd correlation kernel, average (f,g) with (f composed with graded parity,-g). This gives (H(t)-H(-t))/2 and preserves every reported odd coefficient. Graded parity negates odd-grade variables and fixes even-grade variables.
